name: session-lab
description: How PingOne and DaVinci sessions and cookies work: a mock session, its cookie, the DaVinci sessionToken and the tokens apps hold, with admin changes (revoke, idle timeout, mfa step-up, sessionToken reuse) and their effect on apps. Mock only: no tenant, no outbound network.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
